tokens.do: Custom properties on :root for colour, space, radius and type; light-dark() or a [data-theme] override for dark mode; @layer to order reset, tokens, components.
tokens.dont: Hard-coded hex values scattered across selectors, or !important to win cascade fights.

motion.do: CSS transitions and the Web Animations API first; wrap motion in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) and check matchMedia in JS; use View Transitions for page/state changes.
motion.dont: A JS animation library for hover effects, or scroll listeners without passive:true.

media.do: with AVIF/WebP, width/height on every , fetchpriority=high on the LCP image, loading=lazy below the fold; WOFF2 variable fonts with font-display:swap and one preload.
media.dont: Background-image heroes (not preloadable), or Google Fonts CSS with six weights.

a11y.do: Native elements first: <button>, <dialog>, <details>, popover; :focus-visible rings; one <main>.
a11y.dont: Div-and-span widgets wired with click handlers.

performance.do: type=module scripts with defer, no render-blocking JS, content-visibility for long pages.

tokens.do: Tokens live in CSS variables; components read them via classes or CSS modules; theme switch flips data-theme on <html>.
tokens.dont: Theme values in JS objects threaded through context and inline styles on every render.

motion.do: CSS transitions or Motion (motion/react) with useReducedMotion(); clean up in useEffect return; View Transitions via startTransition where supported.
motion.dont: Animating layout properties with state every frame, or effects without cleanup.

media.do: Explicit width/height, loading=lazy, decoding=async; a single font loader in index.html; import heavy widgets with React.lazy + Suspense.
media.dont: Importing whole icon packs or image files into the main bundle.

a11y.do: Semantic JSX; headless libraries (React Aria, Radix) for complex widgets; manage focus on route change.
a11y.dont: onClick on div; aria-* sprinkled without roles and keyboard handling.

performance.do: React Compiler or targeted memo for hot lists; virtualise long lists; useTransition for expensive updates; keep INP <= 200 ms.
performance.dont: Global context that re-renders the whole tree on each keystroke.

tokens.do: Tokens in a global CSS file imported from the root layout; next-themes or a blocking script for theme without flash.
tokens.dont: CSS-in-JS runtimes that force client components for static content.

motion.do: Keep motion in small client components; respect prefers-reduced-motion; experimental viewTransition/React ViewTransition for route changes.
motion.dont: Marking a whole page 'use client' to animate one heading.

media.do: next/image with sizes and priority on the LCP image; next/font for self-hosted, subset fonts with display swap.
media.dont: Raw for large photos, or fonts from a third-party CSS URL.

a11y.do: Use the root layout for <html lang>; route announcer is built in, still move focus to <h1> on navigation in custom flows.

performance.do: Server Components by default, streaming with Suspense, static/ISR where possible, next/script strategy=lazyOnload for third parties.
performance.dont: Fetching in client effects what the server could render.

tokens.do: Tokens in a global stylesheet; scoped <style> in components reads the variables.
tokens.dont: Duplicating token values inside each component's scoped styles.

motion.do: CSS-first motion; ClientRouter view transitions honour reduced motion automatically — keep custom ones in a no-preference query.
motion.dont: Hydrating a framework island just to animate on scroll.

media.do: astro:assets <Image>/<Picture> for AVIF/WebP and dimensions; the Fonts API or self-hosted WOFF2 with preload.
media.dont: Unoptimised images in /public for content photos.

a11y.do: Static HTML is the default; islands get client:visible or client:idle and keep accessible markup server-rendered.

performance.do: Zero JS by default; ship islands only where interaction exists; prefetch links on hover.
performance.dont: Wrapping the whole layout in a React island.

tokens.do: CSS variables in a global file; v-bind() in <style> only for truly dynamic values.
tokens.dont: Hard-coded colours in scoped styles per component.

motion.do: <Transition> with CSS classes; check usePreferredReducedMotion (VueUse) or the media query; remove listeners in onBeforeUnmount.
motion.dont: JS hooks for transitions that CSS can do.

media.do: defineAsyncComponent for heavy widgets; native lazy images with dimensions.

a11y.do: Native elements and headless libraries (Reka UI) for complex widgets; v-bind aria state.
a11y.dont: @click on div without role and keydown.

performance.do: shallowRef for large data; v-memo/v-once for static parts; virtualise long lists.

tokens.do: Tokens in assets/css imported in nuxt.config css; Nuxt UI theme via app.config when used.

media.dont: Remote font CSS links in the head.

a11y.do: useHead({ htmlAttrs: { lang } }); route announcer component; focus management on navigation.

tokens.do: CSS variables in app.css; component styles read them; theme via data attribute set in hooks or app.html.

motion.do: svelte/transition and svelte/motion with prefersReducedMotion from svelte/motion; effects clean up in $effect return.

performance.do: SSR + prerender where possible; load functions for data; snapshot/lazy import for heavy parts.

tokens.do: Site Settings global colours and global fonts; widgets reference globals, not literal values; container (flexbox/grid) layout.

media.do: Optimised image sizes per breakpoint; enable lazy load; load fonts locally (Elementor > Settings > Performance).

performance.do: Turn on Optimized DOM, improved CSS/asset loading and inline font icons; keep sections flat with containers.

tokens.do: Global classes and theme styles; colour palette and CSS variables defined once; BEM-like class naming.

motion.do: Interactions with a reduced-motion check in custom CSS; native CSS animations over third-party scripts.

media.do: Responsive image sizes and lazy load; self-host fonts via custom fonts.

performance.do: Disable unused features; keep the DOM shallow; load scripts conditionally.

tokens.do: settings_schema.json colour schemes and type settings output as CSS variables in theme.liquid; section blocks use those variables.

motion.do: CSS transitions with a reduced-motion guard; web components for interactivity, cleaned up in disconnectedCallback.

motion.do: withAnimation and transitions; read @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) to swap moves for fades.
